verdict.rationale: A corporate card and rewards product could reasonably publish a developer API with an OpenAPI spec, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such spec: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file is a marketing and guide index, not a machine-readable API spec, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
